Decisions are decentralised to Member State level; account administration is central.

value_statement: Price calculation and publication, platform establishment and management, registry recording and cancellation are assigned to the Commission; sale and repurchase are obligations of the Member State where the declarant is established, executed through the Commission-run platform. Central infrastructure; decentralised commercial counterparty.
inference_rule: Read the origin positions of QR-0055, QR-0059 (Member State) and QR-0056, QR-0061, QR-0062 (Commission) and of NA-0041, NA-0042, NA-0039.

value_statement: Differentiated by function: central (Commission) for information infrastructure, accounts, price, platform and review input; Member State level for binding decisions. The arrangement is not summarised as 'centralised' or 'decentralised' (an arrangement strongly central in one function and decentralised in another is not described by one label).
inference_rule: Qualitative juxtaposition of PROP CENT_AUTH, CENT_CERT and CENT_ENFORCE.

value_statement: Importers established in a Member State apply directly; an importer not established in a Member State can apply only through an indirect customs representative (A5(2)); an established importer may appoint one (A5(1)). Intermediation is therefore mandatory for non-established importers and optional for established ones.
inference_rule: Read the conditions of QR-0007 and its origin position; the representative's constitution is external (flagged).

value_statement: Whether the grant of the status of authorised CBAM declarant is a necessary stage for importing in-scope goods depends on the absence of alternative paths; the derogations (A2(3), A2(4), A2(7), A5(4)) rest on thresholds and definitions in external instruments, so the claim is undetermined.

path_semantics: Path step = a relation of types delegation_authorization or authority_control with modality obligation; successive steps are linked by explicit rules (A17(1) 'application ... submitted in accordance with Article 5'; A4 and A25(1) restricting importation to the status); reachability alone is not used.
aggregation_rule: Positional value stated for the relation within ARCH-01 only.
